litigation.mdlName: In re: Lyft, Inc. Passenger Sexual Assault Litigation
litigation.court: U.S. District Court, Northern District of California

phase: Early pretrial stage; federal cases growing quickly
phaseDetail: The JPML created MDL-3171 on February 5, 2026 over Lyft's opposition. The federal docket roughly doubled between the August and October 2026 JPML reports. No bellwether trial date or settlement program was identified in records reviewed October 17, 2026. A separate California state-court coordinated proceeding (JCCP No. 5061) also handles Lyft cases.

settlements.label: No settlement program announced
settlements.detail: No global settlement program or public payout schedule for MDL-3171 was identified in records reviewed October 17, 2026. The MDL is in its first year of pretrial proceedings.
settlements.source: JPML transfer order and October 1, 2026 JPML report
settlements.individualClaims: No official individual payout amounts have been published.

keyDates.label: MDL-3171 created
keyDates.detail: The JPML centralized 17 actions from 10 districts before Judge Rita F. Lin in the Northern District of California. Lyft had opposed centralization.

keyDates.label: 134 pending federal cases
keyDates.detail: Up from 72 on the August 3 JPML report.

updates.summary: JPML reports 134 pending actions in MDL-3171 on October 1, 2026, up from 106 on September 1; 148 total historical actions are reported separately.
JPML reports 106 pending actions on September 1, 2026, compared with 72 on August 3.
JPML reports 72 pending actions in MDL-3171 on August 3, 2026.
The JPML created MDL-3171 before Judge Rita F. Lin, rejecting Lyft's argument that claims should proceed in the California state coordinated proceeding.
